Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops

Class HydrateEquilibriumDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops.HydrateEquilibriumDiagnostics
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class HydrateEquilibriumDiagnostics extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable numerical and fluid-phase evidence from a hydrate-temperature calculation. Numerical convergence and CO2 saturation describe the calculated state, not experimental qualification, drilling-fluid applicability, or the amount of hydrate formed.

  • Constructor Details

    • HydrateEquilibriumDiagnostics

      HydrateEquilibriumDiagnostics(SystemInterface system, boolean converged, double hydrateResidual, double trialDistance)
      Captures independent values rather than retaining a mutable thermodynamic system.
      Parameters:
      system - calculated system
      converged - whether the hydrate water-fugacity equation converged
      hydrateResidual - dimensionless 1 - hydrate-water fugacity / fluid-water fugacity
      trialDistance - minimum vapour/liquid CO2 trial distance for the aqueous feed, or NaN if not assessed
